title: AMBA CHI subordinate node (SN-F) for a small memory: ReadNoSnp, WriteNoSnpPtl and WriteNoSnpFull over the RXREQ, RXDAT, TXRSP and TXDAT link channels with L-Credit flow control

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: a request got an error response: DERR (address beyond the memory) or NDERR (opcode or size not supported)

irqs.name: PROTO
irqs.desc: a flit was dropped: it came without an L-Credit, or it was write data not expected (opcode, DBID or DataID)

notes: rxreqflitv, rxreqflit, rxreqlcrdv, rxdatflitv, rxdatflit, rxdatlcrdv, txrspflitv, txrspflit, txrsplcrdv, txdatflitv, txdatflit and txdatlcrdv are the CHI link channels to the home node; they pass through unchanged. The registers report the node's error events.
The core parameters LINES (16), RQ (4) and NDC (2) keep their defaults.
